description: This file defines the DefaultTimeoutConfig class, which provides configuration for timeout settings related to circuit breaker behavior in a MongoDB-related context. It reads configuration values, constructs Duration objects, and implements the TimeoutConfig interface.

classes.name: DefaultTimeoutConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing TimeoutConfig interface, providing timeout durations for call and reset operations, constructed from a Config object.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a DefaultTimeoutConfig instance from a Config object, applying fallback logic.

methods.name: getCall
methods.description: Returns the Duration for the call timeout.

methods.name: getReset
methods.description: Returns the Duration for the reset timeout.
